channel.title: Paintbox Collection
channel.description: Quantel Paintbox Collection — AI Nostalgia Edition

item.title: Paintbox Collection 2026.10.7
item.description:
• The palette's mixing area works again (V-Series, DPB, Harry, HAL, Henry): a stroke paints the brush colour from where the pen went down, so colours can be laid in and mixed; a still tap picks the colour under the pen and paints nothing. (Since 2 Oct the press picked the colour under the pen and the stroke painted with it, so nothing new could be mixed.)
  • Pots: a quick tap picks the pot's colour; hold for 0.6 s to drop the brush colour in.

item.title: Paintbox Collection 2026.10.6.1
item.description:
• Digital Fine Art: with the palette up, a press anywhere on the picture now grabs the colour under the pen at once (it was a tap on the pen-up, which a deliberate pen press never satisfied — mouse picked, pen did not). Pots, the columns and the mixing area keep their tap grammar.
  • Otherwise as the previous release.

item.title: Paintbox Collection 2026.10.6
item.description:
• "Check for Updates…" is now in the Paintbox Collection menu of the loading screen, under About (it was missing in every build so far). Updates are checked from the loading screen, not from inside a machine.
  • Otherwise as 2026.10.5.3. Apple silicon Macs, macOS 26 or later. A Universal edition for macOS 15 and Intel Macs is a separate download with its own updates.

item.title: Paintbox Collection 2026.10.5.3
item.description:
• Digital Paint Box: the blue Quantel P[ai]ntbox box on the PAINTING menu.
  • From 2026.10.5.2: Digital Fine Art (DFA-7000, 1981 V1), the prototype that became the Paint Box, first in the machine list; ⌘F fills the screen and blacks out the desktop around the picture (HIDE DESKTOP on the full pages turns this off); SELECT FOLDER on the Paintbox full page; SELECT MACHINE on Harry's setup page.
  • Apple silicon Macs, macOS 26 or later. Updates arrive through Paintbox Collection › Check for Updates…

item.title: Paintbox Collection 2026.10.5.2
item.description:
• NEW: Digital Fine Art (DFA-7000, 1981 V1), the prototype that became the Paint Box, first in the machine list: the palette along the foot of the frame, paint, wash, texture and clear, four brush sizes, and the terminal.
  • ⌘F fills the screen and blacks out the desktop around the picture (wallpaper, icons, Dock and menu bar); ⌘F again or quitting brings it all back. HIDE DESKTOP on the full pages turns this off.
  • SELECT FOLDER on the Paintbox full page (V-Series, DPB, HAL) picks the framestore folder at once; SELECT MACHINE on Harry's setup page goes back to the loading screen.
  • Apple silicon Macs, macOS 26 or later. Updates arrive through Paintbox Collection › Check for Updates…

item.title: Paintbox Collection 2026.10.5
item.description:
• First test release of the Quantel Paintbox Collection: Digital Paint Box, Paintbox V-Series, Harry, HAL and Henry, chosen from one loading screen.
  • The picture goes to the screen through Metal, on the display's own clock.
  • Apple silicon Macs, macOS 26 or later. Updates arrive through Paintbox Collection › Check for Updates…
